It looks like we have a launch file working with that test https://github.com/ros-navigation/navigation2/blob/517ebf4594fe01e1cefd5a9611eff10d24e161e3/nav2_costmap_2d/test/integration/CMakeLists.txt#L96-L103.

Luckily we don't use this launch pattern much outside of costmap2D + system test packages (and given we see system test failures, I think most of those are alright as they properly use a launch-testing framework that this does not)

comments.body:
Yes! In #5771 I was originally trying to fix the race condition in footprint test. However, I just realized that instead of modifying the launch file, I should probably convert the footprint test into a proper gtest, similar to this example:
https://github.com/ros-navigation/navigation2/blob/913205382cb6a660505a026b4f83c07b7d787079/nav2_costmap_2d/test/integration/CMakeLists.txt#L51-L56

It may also be worth reviewing the other tests to see whether any of them should be converted to gtests instead of being implemented as executables launched via costmap_tests_launch.py

So I think the steps for this PR should be:
1. Revert the changes to launch.py made in #5771
2. You should now be able to see the failing tests, please fix them!
3. Review https://github.com/ros-navigation/navigation2/blob/main/nav2_costmap_2d/test/integration/CMakeLists.txt and determine which tests should use `nav2_add_gtest` and which should use `nav2_add_test`
